messages:
alex_support: Heads-up — customer acct_9242 reports applying a second coupon overwrites their existing trial credit instead of stacking. They expected balances to add up. Repro steps and logs below, any ideas?

sarah_cs: assigning. can you paste the exact API calls and responses? also need their account plan (free/trial/paid). :mag_right:

alex_support: plan: free-trial (30d). Calls: 
```
POST /v1/customers/acct_9242/promos
{
  "promo_code": "WELCOME50"
}
Response 200
{
  "applied_amount": 50,
  "balance": 50
}

POST /v1/customers/acct_9242/promos
{
  "promo_code": "SPRING10"
}
Response 200
{
  "applied_amount": 10,
  "balance": 10  // expected 60, got 10
}
```

Also attached relevant audit events from our billing log: 
```
2025-02-02T15:01:12Z acct_9242 promo_applied code=WELCOME50 amount=50
2025-02-02T15:12:03Z acct_9242 promo_applied code=SPRING10 amount=10
2025-02-02T15:12:03Z acct_9242 promo_removed code=WELCOME50 reason=overwrite
```

That last line is surprising — why would the engine emit promo_removed right after applying the second code?

maria_billing: thanks. quick Q: was the first promo marked as "non-stackable" in the promo config? some promo types (trial grants) historically were exclusive. can you share promo ids?

alex_support: promo IDs: WELCOME50 (id p_77), SPRING10 (id p_89). I double-checked the promo metadata in the console: both are flagged as "stackable: true" in the UI.

promo_bot: :information_source: Promo engine config snapshot (prod-1) at 2025-02-01 08:00 UTC: default_stack_policy=stack_if_allowed, override_flags=[p_77:stackable=true, p_89:stackable=true]

eng_jordan: pinged for visibility @eng_jordan. can you grep for recent changes to promo apply logic? this smells like the last patch we merged to billing-service.

eng_jordan: looking. can you repro on staging? give me a repro script I can run. if staging shows same behavior i'll dig into commit history.

alex_support: repro script (curl):
```
curl -X POST https://api.staging.redwood.ai/v1/customers/acct_9242/promos -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"promo_code":"WELCOME50"}'
curl -X POST https://api.staging.redwood.ai/v1/customers/acct_9242/promos -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"promo_code":"SPRING10"}'
```

eng_jordan: ran this on staging -> I can reproduce. audit shows billing-service emitted an explicit promo_replace operation. digging into recent PRs, there was one that tightened promo lifecycle to prevent duplicate stacking on gift cards, but it appears the scope rule was too broad and hit trial credits. PR ref: billing/PR#4226 (merged 2025-01-30).

eng_jordan: root cause hypothesis: new rule treated any existing active promo as exclusive unless promo.metadata.type=="stackable_trial". our UI flag sets "stackable":true but the service reads "type". so mismatch between console metadata and service schema.

maria_billing: ugh config divergence. is there a quick mitigation? we have a paying customer impacted.

eng_jordan: short-term: we can patch billing-service to accept the "stackable" boolean OR update DB for these promos to set type=stackable_trial. faster path is DB update for the two promos and any others in the same bucket. longer-term: align the schemas and add an integration test.

alex_support: customer prefers immediate fix. can we do the DB patch and then reapply SPRING10 so balance becomes 60?

eng_jordan: yes. i'll run a scoped DB migration to set type=stackable_trial for p_77 and p_89 and any promo where stackable=true and type in (null, legacy). will post runbook and ETA.

promo_bot: :white_check_mark: Promo-metadata bulk update job scheduled by eng_jordan for 2025-02-02T20:00Z. Job ID job_9882.

eng_jordan: migration ran at 2025-02-02T20:03Z. verified audit: 
```
2025-02-02T20:03:05Z promo_meta_update p_77 type=stackable_trial
2025-02-02T20:03:05Z promo_meta_update p_89 type=stackable_trial
```

alex_support: re-applied SPRING10 for acct_9242 and confirmed balance is now 60. customer notified and happy. created TKT-3598 to track follow-up (schema alignment + test).

sarah_cs: leaving notes: workaround=DB meta patch, follow-ups=add integration test + update console to write both fields. assigned to eng_jordan. :spiral_note_pad:

alex_support: thanks everyone — closing on my side. :thumbsup:
